title: Zone (snapshot 'zones', GET /api/zones)
description: One zone with its Silent Zone numbers. Fill the map shape by coverage; red when silent.

hard_hit.description: Marked by the dispatcher, or (heat) inside an active alert's zones.

quiet.description: Fewer than a quarter of the expected reports.

unheard.description: Warning coverage under 25% of 10 or more registered people.

expected.description: Expected reports; null when not hard-hit.

actual.description: Reports placed in the zone (not the server's own).

lines.description: The zone card's explanation, one fact per line.

task_case_id.description: The open welfare-check zone task, if any.
